title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 28, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.5 (Peaked September 28, 2026 at 15:19 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 317 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Sunlight takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth. 🌎💫

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
